WITH RECURSIVE
needed10(file,node) AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT file,id FROM node WHERE kind IN (197) UNION SELECT p.file,p.id FROM needed10 k CROSS JOIN node n ON n.file=k.file AND n.id=k.node CROSS JOIN node p ON p.file=n.file AND p.id=n.parent WHERE p.kind IN (226)),
bounds7(file,node,last) AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT k.file,k.node,n."last" FROM r7 k CROSS JOIN node n ON n.file=k.file AND n.id=k.node),
regions7(file,node,last) AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT b.file,b.node,b.last FROM bounds7 b WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bounds7 outer_region WHERE outer_region.file=b.file AND outer_region.node<b.node AND outer_region.last>=b.node)),
-- frontier outputs
r0(file,node) AS (
SELECT file,node FROM r7
UNION
SELECT file,node FROM r9
UNION
SELECT file,node FROM r6
),
-- utility[0]
r1(file,node) AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT a0n0.file,a0n0.id FROM node AS a0n0 WHERE a0n0.kind IN (145)
UNION
SELECT a1n0.file,a1n0.id FROM node AS a1n0 WHERE a1n0.kind IN (197) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r10 k WHERE k.file=a1n0.file AND k.node=a1n0.id))
),
-- origin candidates
r3(file,node) AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT file,node FROM r1
),
-- utility[3]
r4(file,node) AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT DISTINCT a3n0.file,a3n0.id FROM node AS a3n0 WHERE a3n0.kind IN (137,138,221,222,223,224)
),
-- origin search stop
r5(file,node) AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT a4n0.file,a4n0.id FROM node AS a4n0 WHERE a4n0.kind IN (145)
UNION
SELECT a5n0.file,a5n0.id FROM node AS a5n0 WHERE a5n0.kind IN (197) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r10 k WHERE k.file=a5n0.file AND k.node=a5n0.id))
),
-- binding search stop
r6(file,node) AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT DISTINCT a7n0.file,a7n0.id FROM node AS a7n0 WHERE a7n0.kind IN (145,197)
),
walk7(file,origin,node,distance) AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT n.file,k.node,n.parent,1 FROM r3 k CROSS JOIN node n ON n.file=k.file AND n.id=k.node WHERE n.parent IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT w.file,w.origin,n.parent,w.distance+1 FROM walk7 w CROSS JOIN node n ON n.file=w.file AND n.id=w.node WHERE n.parent IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5 s WHERE s.file=w.file AND s.node=w.node)),
pairs7(file,origin,node,distance) AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT w.* FROM walk7 w JOIN r4 f ON f.file=w.file AND f.node=w.node),
r7(file,node) AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT DISTINCT file,node FROM pairs7),
-- demanded binding candidates
r9(file,node) AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT DISTINCT a8n0.file,a8n0.id FROM r11 AS seed8 CROSS JOIN node AS a8n0 ON a8n0.file=seed8.file AND a8n0.id=seed8.node WHERE a8n0.kind IN (1)
),
-- utility[7] for consumer kinds
r10(file,node) AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT a9n0.file,a9n0.id FROM needed10 AS keys9 CROSS JOIN node AS a9n0 ON a9n0.file=keys9.file AND a9n0.id=keys9.node CROSS JOIN node AS a9n1 ON a9n1.file=a9n0.file AND a9n1.id=a9n0.parent WHERE a9n1.kind IN (125)
UNION
SELECT a10n0.file,a10n0.id FROM needed10 AS keys10 CROSS JOIN node AS a10n0 ON a10n0.file=keys10.file AND a10n0.id=keys10.node CROSS JOIN node AS a10n1 ON a10n1.file=a10n0.file AND a10n1.id=a10n0.parent CROSS JOIN node AS a10n2 ON a10n2.file=a10n0.file AND a10n2.id=a10n0.next WHERE a10n1.kind IN (207) AND a10n2.kind IN (158,224)
UNION
SELECT a11n0.file,a11n0.id FROM needed10 AS keys11 CROSS JOIN node AS a11n0 ON a11n0.file=keys11.file AND a11n0.id=keys11.node CROSS JOIN node AS a11n1 ON a11n1.file=a11n0.file AND a11n1.id=a11n0.parent CROSS JOIN node AS a11n2 ON a11n2.file=a11n1.file AND a11n2.id=a11n1.prev WHERE a11n1.kind IN (158) AND a11n2.kind IN (1) AND node_regex(0,a11n2.file,a11n2.id)
UNION
SELECT a12n0.file,a12n0.id FROM needed10 AS keys12 CROSS JOIN node AS a12n0 ON a12n0.file=keys12.file AND a12n0.id=keys12.node CROSS JOIN node AS a12n1 ON a12n1.file=a12n0.file AND a12n1.id=a12n0.parent CROSS JOIN node AS a12n2 ON a12n2.file=a12n1.file AND a12n2.id=a12n1.prev WHERE a12n1.kind IN (158) AND relation_pattern(1,a12n2.file,a12n2.id) AND a12n2.kind IN (204)
UNION
SELECT a13n0.file,a13n0.id FROM needed10 AS keys13 CROSS JOIN node AS a13n0 ON a13n0.file=keys13.file AND a13n0.id=keys13.node CROSS JOIN node AS a13n1 ON a13n1.file=a13n0.file AND a13n1.id=a13n0.parent CROSS JOIN node AS a13n2 ON a13n2.file=a13n1.file AND a13n2.parent=a13n1.id CROSS JOIN node AS a13n3 ON a13n3.file=a13n2.file AND a13n3.id=a13n2.next CROSS JOIN node AS a13n4 ON a13n4.file=a13n0.file AND a13n4.id=a13n0.prev WHERE a13n1.kind IN (215) AND a13n2.kind IN (1) AND node_regex(2,a13n2.file,a13n2.id) AND node_regex(3,a13n3.file,a13n3.id) AND node_regex(3,a13n4.file,a13n4.id)
UNION
SELECT a14n0.file,a14n0.id FROM r10 AS seed14 CROSS JOIN node AS a14n1 ON a14n1.file=seed14.file AND a14n1.id=seed14.node CROSS JOIN node AS a14n0 ON a14n0.file=a14n1.file AND a14n0.parent=a14n1.id WHERE a14n1.kind IN (226) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM needed10 k WHERE k.file=a14n0.file AND k.node=a14n0.id)
),
-- utility[9] within r7
r11(file,node) AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT a15n0.file,a15n0.id FROM regions7 AS domain15 CROSS JOIN node AS a15n1 ON a15n1.file=domain15.file AND a15n1.id>=domain15.node AND a15n1.id<=domain15.last CROSS JOIN node AS a15n0 ON a15n0.file=a15n1.file AND a15n0.parent=a15n1.id WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT 1) AS unit16 CROSS JOIN node AS a16n1 ON a16n1.file=a15n0.file AND a16n1.id=a15n0.prev WHERE node_regex(4,a16n1.file,a16n1.id)) AND a15n1.kind IN (199,200)
UNION
SELECT a17n0.file,a17n0.id FROM regions7 AS domain17 CROSS JOIN node AS a17n1 ON a17n1.file=domain17.file AND a17n1.id>=domain17.node AND a17n1.id<=domain17.last CROSS JOIN node AS a17n0 ON a17n0.file=a17n1.file AND a17n0.parent=a17n1.id CROSS JOIN node AS a17n2 ON a17n2.file=a17n0.file AND a17n2.id=a17n0.prev WHERE a17n1.kind IN (137,228) AND node_regex(5,a17n2.file,a17n2.id)
UNION
SELECT a18n0.file,a18n0.id FROM r11 AS seed18 CROSS JOIN node AS a18n1 ON a18n1.file=seed18.file AND a18n1.id=seed18.node CROSS JOIN node AS a18n0 ON a18n0.file=a18n1.file AND a18n0.parent=a18n1.id WHERE a18n1.kind IN (180,181,184,201,216,218,226)
),
binding_seeds(file,node,atom) AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT n.file,n.id,relation_leaf_atom(n.file,n.id,n.atom) FROM r9 t CROSS JOIN node n ON n.file=t.file AND n.id=t.node WHERE 1 AND n.named),
binding_walk(file,atom,witness,node) AS (SELECT n.file,t.atom,t.node,n.parent FROM binding_seeds t CROSS JOIN node n ON n.file=t.file AND n.id=t.node WHERE n.parent IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT w.file,w.atom,w.witness,n.parent FROM binding_walk w CROSS JOIN node n ON n.file=w.file AND n.id=w.node WHERE n.parent IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r6 s WHERE s.file=w.file AND s.node=w.node)),
binding_choices(file,node,atom,witness) AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT w.file,w.node,w.atom,MIN(w.witness) FROM binding_walk w JOIN r7 k ON k.file=w.file AND k.node=w.node GROUP BY w.file,w.node,w.atom),
origin_choices AS (SELECT p.file,p.origin,b.atom,b.witness,p.node AS ancestor,p.distance,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.file,p.origin,b.atom ORDER BY p.distance) AS choice FROM pairs7 p JOIN binding_choices b ON b.file=p.file AND b.node=p.node),
capture_demand AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT file,origin,atom,witness,ancestor,distance FROM origin_choices WHERE choice=1)
SELECT file,origin,atom,witness,ancestor,distance FROM capture_demand ORDER BY file,origin,atom
